text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Volume and trend across the practice. Counts and

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bands, never a list of people.

svg.text: Define a cohort

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, monospace

svg.text: /analytics/cohorts

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A date window is required — an unbounded cohort is

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: just the whole record. The purpose is a required

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: field.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Evaluate it

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, monospace

svg.text: automatic

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Subjects come back as pseudonyms salted with the

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: cohort’s own id, so two extracts cannot be joined.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check the data quality

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, monospace

svg.text: /analytics/quality

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: What is missing, what is uncoded. A cohort built on

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a field nobody fills is a finding about the clinic,

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: not the patients.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Export

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, monospace

svg.text: /analytics/exports

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Carries the definition, its version and the exact

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: column list, so a figure quoted next year is

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: traceable.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Guards, branches and the things that refuse

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The guarantee is an absence, not a filter

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: No route in this panel accepts a name, a mobile number or a record number, and the role holds no patient:read. Nothing is being filtered out — there

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: is nowhere to send such a request.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Small cells are suppressed, not zeroed

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A cell below the threshold comes back null with a count of how many were suppressed. Reporting zero would be a false statement about the data.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Keys are salted per cohort

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The same patient has unrelated keys in two cohorts. Joining extracts on a shared key is the standard way a pseudonymised dataset gets re-identified.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Analytics depends on reports commercially

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The module is gated on the clinic also having reporting. Selling the research layer to a practice that cannot answer "how many patients did we see

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: last month" is the wrong order.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: What this role cannot do, at the server

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Read a patient, open a consultation, see a name, a number or a record number, or reach any clinical screen. The role

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: is defined by what it cannot address, not by what it chooses not to show.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, monospace

svg.text: routes: /analytics /cohorts /quality /exports
